name: gke workload scaling troubleshooting
description: Use this skill to systematically diagnose and resolve HorizontalPodAutoscaler (HPA) failures on GKE — metrics reported as <unknown, FailedGet events, missing resource requests, custom/external metrics-pipeline breakage, HPA that refuses to scale up or down, scale-to/from-zero issues, and slow HPA reaction on large clusters. This skill operates non-interactively and enforces a read-only diagnostics
